common_preconditions: Use only campaign-owned UTF-8 items.txt fixtures and isolated temporary HOME/TEMP.
Launch the exact pinned sk.exe under a real Playtestr PTY. A bounded stdin adapter passes only fixture bytes to Skim and inherits the PTY for rendered output and keyboard input.
The adapter invokes the binary directly, without a shell; no --interactive, --cmd, --listen, --remote, preview, shell integration, history, or external target command is used.
Capture positive rendered readiness, final screen, exact exit status, and process-tree cleanup. Output-byte framing is not inferred from screen text.

scenarios.task: Choose the only exact-query candidate
scenarios.positive_evidence: Rendered candidate row and exact output file contain cedar; status 0.

scenarios.task: Move off the default row and accept a nondefault result
scenarios.positive_evidence: Rendered selection moves to amber and exact output contains amber only.

scenarios.task: Narrow candidates by typing a query, then accept
scenarios.positive_evidence: Query and matching row are visible before accept; output is violet.

scenarios.task: Select two items in multi-select mode
scenarios.positive_evidence: Both marked rows render selected and output has the two exact lines in input order.

scenarios.task: Preserve the query alongside the chosen item
scenarios.positive_evidence: Final terminal output shows the query and selected value in documented order; raw byte framing is separately scoped.

scenarios.task: Find and return a wide and combining Unicode entry
scenarios.positive_evidence: Unicode query and full selected source bytes are visible and exact in output.

scenarios.task: Navigate an unsorted candidate list without changing source order
scenarios.positive_evidence: Third input item is selected; exact candidate list remained in its declared order.

scenarios.task: Accept a long candidate and preserve its complete output bytes
scenarios.positive_evidence: Visible tail marker identifies the intended row and output retains the full fixture line.

scenarios.task: Open selector with empty stdin and exit cleanly
scenarios.positive_evidence: Empty state is visible; abort yields no selection and bounded cleanup.

scenarios.task: Search for absent text and confirm no candidate
scenarios.positive_evidence: No-match state is visible and empty result is distinguished from a selected row.

scenarios.task: Reject an unknown CLI option before opening the PTY UI
scenarios.positive_evidence: Bounded parser diagnostic identifies the unsupported option; no TUI is launched.

scenarios.task: Reject an unsupported negative minimum height
scenarios.positive_evidence: CLI returns a bounded option error without target data mutation.

scenarios.task: Choose the unique row in the smallest declared viewport
scenarios.positive_evidence: Query, one result, and selected value remain readable after initial draw.

scenarios.task: Resize during search, then select the intended row
scenarios.positive_evidence: Final screen redraws at the new size and exact selection is violet.

scenarios.task: Move repeatedly and return to a positive selected row
scenarios.positive_evidence: Final highlight and output agree after repeated navigation.

scenarios.task: Use the documented exact-search mode and select an exact candidate
scenarios.positive_evidence: The exact candidate is visible and accepted while fuzzy-only alternatives are excluded.

scenarios.task: Search with non-ASCII input and accept the corresponding item
scenarios.positive_evidence: Rendered query and selected UTF-8 line remain exact.

scenarios.task: Navigate a long list and select a late row
scenarios.positive_evidence: Late row is visible at selection time and exact output is item-039.

scenarios.task: Cancel after editing the query without accepting a result
scenarios.positive_evidence: Abort is shown and output file stays empty; input fixture hash is unchanged.

scenarios.task: Exercise NUL-separated output mode with a selected item
scenarios.positive_evidence: Rendered selection is cedar and status is 0; exact NUL framing is not inferred from the terminal screen and is measured by a separate filter-mode case.

risk_pairs: Resize during Unicode search then verify exact source bytes.
Cancel a multi-select interaction after one row has been toggled; no selection output may persist.
Small viewport with a late long-list selection must preserve visible identity.
Long UTF-8 item is emitted with exact NUL framing after selection.
